scope: All 349 OSM city, town and village records in Shropshire and Telford and Wrekin.
methodology: Checked manifest/package completeness, region-safe identities, source provenance and original-versus-active visitor boundaries.
Checked curated See, daytime Eat, trails and practical categories for unresolved IDs, duplicates, score order, caps and out-of-boundary records.
Applied the strict 0-3 tourist-town evidence rule; food and practical amenities do not create a town rating.

Normalised the earliest dated fabric or historic component from cached official Historic England list-entry text. Administrative listing dates and restoration-only dates were excluded. Uncaptured entries remain unknown and are explicitly listed.
Research gaps are reported separately and do not masquerade as verified facts.
